f5_public_readiness_unchanged.invariant: The F5 product — 2D/list SemanticList + Graph2D across all 7 destinations (Overview, Recall, Knowledge, Timeline, Goals, Sources, Health) — is complete and public-ready independent of F6 outcome. This invariant holds regardless of whether F6 reaches GO or NO_GO or remains DEFERRED indefinitely. F6 is strictly additive and optional; it cannot degrade, modify, or precondition the F5 product.
f5_public_readiness_unchanged.non_negotiable: No F6 work may modify F5 source files, routes, schemas, or test suites in a way that conditions F5 correctness on F6 outcome. Any such modification is a protocol violation and must be reverted before F5 readiness can be re-asserted.

possible_values.GO: All 7 conjunctive threshold groups record PASS, study analysis returns STUDY_GO, and all 4 review sign-offs are recorded. The capability-gated optional 3D path renderer is integrated into the F5 product behind CAPABILITY_3D_PATH_RENDERER. The 2D/list product remains the default.
possible_values.NO_GO: Any single threshold group returns FAIL, INCONCLUSIVE, or PENDING at decision time. All F6 spike code (11 new source files, 4 modified files, F6-exclusive npm/Rust dependencies, documentation claims) is deleted per the mandatory deletion plan in evidence/F6/run-001/no-go-branch-decision.json. The F5 product is returned to its unmodified baseline state.
possible_values.DEFERRED: Current state. No study has been run. All threshold evidence is PENDING_EXECUTION. No GO or NO_GO determination can be made.

gate_artifacts.description: Frozen pre-registration of the F6 study protocol: z-axis formula, 7 conjunctive GO thresholds, deletion inventory, spike inventory, immutable path pairs, and analysis plan. Frozen before any spike implementation or study data collection.
gate_artifacts.non_negotiable: The protocol in this file is frozen at task 6.1.x and cannot be changed post-hoc to accommodate study outcomes.

gate_artifacts.description: Protocol and schema for performance profiling of the 3D spike: FPS measurement, idle quiet detection, heap/GC/VRAM sampling, and contention load conditions. Defines ProfilingSession API wired into graphCanvas3DSpike.ts. No measurements taken — protocol only.
Study execution status: participant enrollment, session completion, randomisation log, counterbalance status, and study commit SHA. Status DEFERRED — no sessions have been run.

Schema for the study analysis output artifact (evidence/F6/run-001/study/analysis/results.json). Defines the go_no_go_determination.verdict field, Wilcoxon test fields, valid_pairs_count, and median_percentage_difference fields that the analysis script must produce.

Protocol schema for all 9 required technical checks (FPS, idle quiet, resource parity, 4 a11y sub-checks, core E2E, SBOM diff). All 9 checks are PENDING_EXECUTION — none can run until the study commit SHA is known and RHW-001 hardware is available.

GO branch decision schema: prerequisite checks for all 7 conjunctive threshold groups, go_activation_rule, go_branch_actions (capability-gated 3D renderer integration), and required review sign-offs. Activates only when all 7 groups record PASS and all 4 reviews are signed.

NO-GO branch deletion plan: activation conditions (any single threshold failure triggers NO-GO), 10-step ordered deletion sequence, 20 MVI checks (13 original + 7 delta), and post-deletion verification requirements. Executes when any GO threshold fails or remains PENDING at decision time.

machine_inventory_validation._description: Defines what the machine-inventory command (CMD-MG-COVERAGE) must verify to confirm either GO or NO-GO outcome. These checks are assertions, not evidence — they validate that the evidence chain is consistent with the declared outcome.
